SELECT CABINET_ID, CABINET_NAME, ASSET_ID, ASSET_NAME, ASSET_IP1, ASSET_IP2 FROM INSPECT_RECORD WHERE CABINET_ID = #{cabinetId}
AND ASSET_STATUS = 1 AND INSPECT_TYPE = 1
AND TARGET_STATUS = 1 AND INSPECT_TYPE = 2
GROUP BY CABINET_ID, CABINET_NAME, ASSET_ID, ASSET_NAME, ASSET_IP1, ASSET_IP2 ORDER BY CABINET_NAME

SELECT ORG_ID, ORG_NAME FROM INSPECT_RECORD
WHERE INSPECT_TYPE = 1 AND ASSET_STATUS = 1
WHERE INSPECT_TYPE = 2 AND TARGET_STATUS = 1
GROUP BY ORG_ID, ORG_NAME ORDER BY ORG_ID

SELECT CABINET_ID, CABINET_NAME, ORG_ID FROM INSPECT_RECORD
WHERE ASSET_STATUS = 1 AND INSPECT_TYPE = 1
WHERE TARGET_STATUS = 1 AND INSPECT_TYPE = 2
GROUP BY CABINET_ID, CABINET_NAME, ORG_ID ORDER BY CABINET_NAME

SELECT cabinet_id, max(inspect_state) inspect_state FROM INSPECT_RECORD WHERE CABINET_ID = #{cabinetId}
AND ASSET_STATUS = 1 AND INSPECT_TYPE = 1
AND TARGET_STATUS = 1 AND INSPECT_TYPE = 2
group by cabinet_id

SELECT asset_id, inspect_code, max(inspect_state) inspect_state FROM INSPECT_RECORD WHERE ASSET_ID = #{assetId}
AND ASSET_STATUS = 1 AND INSPECT_TYPE = 1
AND TARGET_STATUS = 1 AND INSPECT_TYPE = 2
group by asset_id, inspect_code
SELECT MODE_TYPE, MODE_NAME FROM INSPECT_RECORD GROUP BY MODE_TYPE, MODE_NAME ORDER BY MODE_TYPE
SELECT TARGET_ITEM, TARGET_NAME, TARGET_STATUS FROM INSPECT_RECORD WHERE MODE_TYPE = #{modeType} GROUP BY TARGET_ITEM, TARGET_NAME, TARGET_STATUS
SELECT ORG_ID, ORG_NAME FROM INSPECT_RECORD WHERE MODE_TYPE = #{modeType} GROUP BY ORG_ID, ORG_NAME
SELECT ASSET_ID, ASSET_NAME, ORG_ID, MAX(ASSET_STATUS) assetStatus FROM INSPECT_RECORD WHERE MODE_TYPE = #{modeType} GROUP BY ASSET_ID, ASSET_NAME, ORG_ID

SELECT ORG_ID, ORG_NAME FROM INSPECT_RECORD GROUP BY ORG_ID, ORG_NAME ORDER BY ORG_ID

SELECT DISTINCT R.ID, R.INSPECT_TIME AS NAME, '1' AS isShare, S.OPERATOR, R.INSPECT_STATE AS inspectStatus FROM INSPECT_RECORD R LEFT JOIN INSPECT_RECORD_SHARE S ON R.ID = S.INSPECT_RECORD_ID WHERE R.INSPECT_CODE = #{jobId} ORDER BY R.INSPECT_TIME DESC
